en: On June 7, 1494, Spain and Portugal, mediated by the papacy, signed the Treaty of Tordesillas, fixing the line of demarcation 370 leagues west of the Cape Verde islands (about 46° W longitude).

title.zh: 明朝建造南京大报恩寺

summary.zh: 1495年，明孝宗下令在南京修建大报恩寺塔，以纪念父母。该塔高约78米，通体琉璃，被誉为“中世纪世界七大奇迹”之一。1856年毁于太平天国战火。

statement.zh: 1495年，明孝宗下令在南京修建大报恩寺塔，以纪念父母。该塔高约78米，通体琉璃，被誉为“中世纪世界七大奇迹”之一。1856年毁于太平天国战火。
statement.en:
In 1495, the Hongzhi Emperor ordered the construction of the Porcelain Tower (Bao'en Temple) in Nanjing to honor his parents. The tower stood about 78 meters high, glazed in white porcelain, and was considered one of the "Seven Wonders of the Medieval World." It was destroyed during the Taiping Rebellion in 1856.

For Asia in 1495, “Ming builds the Porcelain Tower of Nanjing” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 神圣罗马帝国帝国改革

summary.zh: 1495年，神圣罗马帝国皇帝马克西米利安一世在沃尔姆斯帝国议会推行改革：宣布“永久公共和平”，禁止诸侯私战；设立帝国最高法院；划分帝国行政圈；征收公共税（公芬尼）。改革试图加强中央集权，但因诸侯抵制而效果有限，帝国仍处于松散联邦状态。

statement.zh: 1495年，神圣罗马帝国皇帝马克西米利安一世在沃尔姆斯帝国议会推行改革：宣布“永久公共和平”，禁止诸侯私战；设立帝国最高法院；划分帝国行政圈；征收公共税（公芬尼）。
statement.en: In 1495, Emperor Maximilian I pushed through reforms at the Diet of Worms: declaring an Eternal Public Peace, banning private feuds; establishing an Imperial Chamber Court; dividing the empire into circles; and levying a common tax (Common Penny).

title.zh: 约翰·卡伯特发现纽芬兰

summary.zh: 1497年5月，受英王亨利七世委托，意大利航海家约翰·卡伯特（乔瓦尼·卡博托）率领50吨的“马修号”从布里斯托尔启航，向西横渡大西洋。6月24日，他到达北美纽芬兰岛（一说布雷顿角），认为是亚洲。他发现了北美丰富的渔业资源（鳕鱼场），为英国后来在北美的殖民提供了依据。

title.zh: 卡博特到达北美

summary.zh: 威尼斯出身的航海家乔瓦尼·卡博托受英王亨利七世特许，率小船“马修号”与十八名船员自布里斯托尔西航，六月抵北美东岸登陆，一般认为在纽芬兰或布雷顿角一带。他误以为所至为亚洲东北，但带回纽芬兰浅滩鳕鱼极丰的消息，英格兰其后即据此主张对北美的领土权利。

statement.zh: 威尼斯出身的航海家乔瓦尼·卡博托受英王亨利七世特许，率小船“马修号”与十八名船员自布里斯托尔西航，六月抵北美东岸登陆，一般认为在纽芬兰或布雷顿角一带。他误以为所至为亚洲东北，但带回纽芬兰浅滩鳕鱼极丰的消息，英格兰其后即据此主张对北美的领土权利。
statement.en:
The Venetian-born navigator Giovanni Caboto, licensed by Henry VII of England, sailed west from Bristol in the small ship Matthew with 18 men and made landfall on the North American coast in June, most probably at Newfoundland or Cape Breton. He believed he had reached north-east Asia, but brought back word of the vast cod stocks of the Grand Banks, and England later based its claims in North America on his voyage.

For North America in 1497, “Cabot reaches North America” is a traceable node of Exploration change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 哥伦布第三次航行发现南美大陆

summary.zh: 1498年5月30日，哥伦布率6艘船第三次西航，于7月31日到达特立尼达岛，并进入帕里亚湾，看到南美洲大陆（今委内瑞拉）。他意识到这是一块新大陆，但始终认为那是亚洲的一部分。由于殖民地管理不善，西班牙王室派专员逮捕哥伦布送回国内，但不久释放。

statement.zh:
1498年5月30日，哥伦布率6艘船第三次西航，于7月31日到达特立尼达岛，并进入帕里亚湾，看到南美洲大陆（今委内瑞拉）。他意识到这是一块新大陆，但始终认为那是亚洲的一部分。由于殖民地管理不善，西班牙王室派专员逮捕哥伦布送回国内，但不久释放。

1498年的西班牙，「哥伦布第三次航行发现南美大陆」属于探索领域。
statement.en:
On May 30, 1498, Columbus set sail with 6 ships on his third voyage. On July 31, he reached Trinidad and entered the Gulf of Paria, sighting the South American mainland (present-day Venezuela). He realized it was a new continent but still believed it was part of Asia. Mismanagement of the colonies led the Spanish crown to send a commissioner who arrested Columbus and sent him back in chains, though he was soon released.

In 1498, “Columbus's third voyage discovers the South American mainland” belongs to the field of Exploration in South America.

For South America in 1498, “Columbus's third voyage discovers the South American mainland” is a traceable node of Exploration change whose significance is best read through later events.

The entry is kept as a concise record of that wider process rather than a standalone narrative.

title.zh: 阿美利哥·韦斯普奇远航南美洲

summary.zh: 意大利航海家阿美利哥·韦斯普奇航行至南美洲海岸，确认其为与亚洲不同的新大陆，后成为“美洲”命名的来源。

statement.zh: 意大利航海家阿美利哥·韦斯普奇航行至南美洲海岸，确认其为与亚洲不同的新大陆，后成为“美洲”命名的来源。他沿岸航行、测量纬度并记录海岸线与居民，把观测与地图结合；与旧说的对照使他相信这是一块独立的大陆。命名经由地图与出版物传播，逐渐固定下来。
statement.en: Italian navigator Amerigo Vespucci sailed to the coast of South America and confirmed it to be a new continent different from Asia, which later became the source of the name "America".

title.zh: 瑞士独立——巴塞尔条约

summary.zh: 1499年，神圣罗马帝国皇帝马克西米利安一世试图将瑞士纳入帝国行政圈，引发“斯瓦比亚战争”。瑞士山地步兵多次击败帝国军队。9月22日，双方签订《巴塞尔条约》，帝国承认瑞士事实上独立，瑞士邦联脱离神圣罗马帝国。

title.zh: 贝宁青铜浮雕

summary.zh: 贝宁宫廷铜匠行会以失蜡法铸造数百方铜板，原钉于王宫木柱之上，表现奥巴出行、战士、葡萄牙火枪手与祭祀场面，人物按尊卑分大小、以高浮雕层层叠置。所用黄铜多来自欧洲输入的手镯锭，是非洲与大西洋贸易交织的物证。

statement.zh: 贝宁宫廷铜匠行会以失蜡法铸造数百方铜板，原钉于王宫木柱之上，表现奥巴出行、战士、葡萄牙火枪手与祭祀场面，人物按尊卑分大小、以高浮雕层层叠置。
statement.en: The palace brass-casters' guild of Benin produced several hundred plaques by the lost-wax method, originally nailed to the wooden pillars of the royal compound, showing the oba in procession, warriors, Portuguese musketeers and ritual scenes, with figures scaled by rank and layered in high relief.

title.zh: 明朝繁盛商业与江南市镇兴起

summary.zh: 1500年左右，明朝江南地区工商业繁荣，苏州、松江、杭州等城市成为丝棉织业中心，出现专业市镇如盛泽、南浔等。资本主义萌芽出现，但受到海禁和重农抑商政策的限制。

statement.zh: 1500年左右，明朝江南地区工商业繁荣，苏州、松江、杭州等城市成为丝棉织业中心，出现专业市镇如盛泽、南浔等。资本主义萌芽出现，但受到海禁和重农抑商政策的限制。
statement.en:
Around 1500, the Jiangnan region of the Ming dynasty experienced remarkable commercial and industrial growth. Cities such as Suzhou, Songjiang, and Hangzhou became centers of silk and cotton textile production, with specialized towns like Shengze and Nanxun emerging. The sprouts of capitalism appeared, but were constrained by the maritime ban and the policy of emphasizing agriculture over commerce.

For Asia in 1500, “Flourishing commerce and rise of market towns in the Jiangnan region of Ming” is a traceable node of Economy change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 纳瓦霍人定居四角落

summary.zh: 纳瓦霍（ Diné）自加拿大北迁至今日四角落地区，以绵羊牧养、编织与银饰工艺构建独特纳瓦霍文化。

statement.zh:
纳瓦霍（Diné）自加拿大北迁至今日四角落地区，以绵羊牧养、编织与银饰工艺构建独特纳瓦霍文化。迁徙之后，他们向普韦布洛等族群学习农耕，又把牧羊与纺织发展成生计与艺术的核心；编织图案与银饰技艺传承至今。居住方式从分散营地逐渐转向定居。

把「纳瓦霍人定居四角落」放回1500年的北美四角落，可以看到社会变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: The Navajo (Diné) migrated north from Canada to today's Four Corners region, building a unique Navajo culture through sheep herding, weaving and silver jewelry.

title.zh: 嘉定竹刻成派

summary.zh: 明代正德、嘉靖间，上海嘉定朱鹤等以深浮雕与透雕刻竹，创立嘉定竹刻流派，文房清供雅致。

statement.zh:
明代正德、嘉靖间，上海嘉定朱鹤等以深浮雕与透雕刻竹，创立嘉定竹刻流派，文房清供雅致。竹刻以留青、浮雕与透雕施于笔筒、臂搁，文人书画趣味融入刀法；嘉定与金陵形成不同风格。工艺与文人审美相互成就。

把「嘉定竹刻成派」放回1500年的中国，可以看到工艺变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: During the Zhengde and Jiajing periods of the Ming Dynasty, Zhu He and others in Jiading, Shanghai, created the Jiading bamboo carving school by carving bamboo with deep relief and openwork, and the study was elegant in the Qing Dynasty.

en: During the Zhengde and Jiajing periods of the Ming Dynasty, Zhu He and others in Jiading, Shanghai, created the Jiading bamboo carving school by carving bamboo with deep relief and openwork, and the study was elegant in the Qing Dynasty.

title.zh: 卢巴王国建立

summary.zh: 刚果盆地的卢巴人以神圣王权与议事会治理，其王权观念与铜雕艺术影响中南非洲诸国。

statement.zh: 刚果盆地的卢巴人以神圣王权与议事会治理，其王权观念与铜雕艺术影响中南非洲诸国。王权带有宗教性质，统治者的人身与器物被视为王国福祉的象征；议事会与地方首领分担治理，使广阔地域得以通过象征与协商维持联系。铜雕、权杖与礼仪器物承载了这套观念，并随贸易与联盟向外传播。卢巴的政治想象因此超出其疆域，成为区域性的文化遗产。
statement.en: The Luba people of the Congo basin govern through sacred kingship and councils; their ideas of kingship and copper sculpture influenced many states of central-southern Africa.

title.zh: 奥斯曼帝国与威尼斯战争结束

summary.zh: 1500年，奥斯曼巴耶济德二世与威尼斯共和国签订和约，威尼斯承认奥斯曼在希腊和阿尔巴尼亚的征服，保留其在爱奥尼亚群岛和克里特的部分据点。威尼斯霸权进一步衰落。

statement.zh: 1500年，奥斯曼巴耶济德二世与威尼斯共和国签订和约，威尼斯承认奥斯曼在希腊和阿尔巴尼亚的征服，保留其在爱奥尼亚群岛和克里特的部分据点。威尼斯霸权进一步衰落。
statement.en: In 1500, Ottoman Sultan Bayezid II and the Republic of Venice signed a peace treaty: Venice recognized Ottoman conquests in Greece and Albania, retaining only some Ionian islands and part of Crete.

title.zh: 卡布拉尔抵达巴西

summary.zh: 葡萄牙人佩德罗·卡布拉尔在驶往印度途中偏离，抵达并宣称巴西为领地。

statement.zh: 葡萄牙人佩德罗·卡布拉尔在驶往印度途中偏离航线，抵达南美东海岸，并宣称巴西为葡萄牙领地。
statement.en: The Portuguese Pedro Cabral, bound for India, deviated from his route, reached the east coast of South America and claimed Brazil for Portugal.

zh: 葡萄牙人佩德罗·卡布拉尔在驶往印度途中偏离航线，抵达南美东海岸，并宣称巴西为葡萄牙领地。
en: The Portuguese Pedro Cabral, bound for India, deviated from his route, reached the east coast of South America and claimed Brazil for Portugal.

statement.zh: 这次意外登陆把葡萄牙的远洋路线与美洲大陆连接起来，也使巴西逐步进入葡萄牙的殖民体系。
statement.en: This accidental landfall linked Portugal's ocean route with the American continent and brought Brazil gradually into the Portuguese colonial system.

zh: 这次意外登陆把葡萄牙的远洋路线与美洲大陆连接起来，也使巴西逐步进入葡萄牙的殖民体系。
en: This accidental landfall linked Portugal's ocean route with the American continent and brought Brazil gradually into the Portuguese colonial system.

statement.zh: 这次航行也被视为葡萄牙在美洲建立殖民据点的开端。
statement.en: The voyage is also treated as the beginning of Portugal's colonial presence in the Americas.
